title: Touring the world: New Zealand, Australia, India
summary: Moore describes the All Stars' tour from San Francisco to New Zealand, Australia and India.

blocks.x: You travelled a lot with him this time.
Yes, we travelled all over the country and left --

Seems like you travelled all over the world.

Yes, I was getting to -- when we left for the Near East -- I remember going from Chicago to San Francisco and we got on Quantas airline, the next stop was Honolulu, and then the next was the Fiji Islands and the last stop was Auckland, New Zealand. And we were in New Zealand for a week, we played little Christchurch and all the different towns in New Zealand. Then following New Zealand we landed in Australia and we were there a week. It's beautiful country, all those were beautiful countries. We left Australia to go to Bombay, India and we stayed in India for about two weeks and then from Bombay, India, we were told that we're going to fly over to Paris, London and back into New York.
